decisions.reason: This shower channel remains very close to our core drainage know-how and customer base, so our existing knowledge and support capabilities make continued improvement and retention likely.

The pump-assisted solution is more complex and requires more learning in installation and service, but it still builds on our drainage competence and in-house R&D strongly enough to justify staying with it.
This tileable floor drain fits our established technical platform and the barrier-free bathroom trend, so we can readily absorb market feedback and keep it in the portfolio.
The stainless steel design grate is a close adjacent product that uses our design-engineering strengths and broad range strategy, making withdrawal within a year relatively unlikely.

As a newer pump-drain shower channel it carries more uncertainty, but it extends knowledge we are already building in pumped drainage and is prominent enough to merit further commercial learning rather than an early exit.
